sources.source_name: Kenneth French Data Library
sources.notes: Retrospective archive used for outcomes. Publication date is that of the pinned public mirror revision (https://github.com/ethanteng/finsight/commit/e033ac1b61c6cca1df75e0beb3b7d1a3ae991609), not original market reporting or first dataset publication. Canonical source: https://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library.html. Series: F-F_Research_Data_Factors: Mkt-RF + RF; RF. Raw SHA256: 9ddf8f5b510f8730acca0fc3d899085d757c92378d7ea66b7c8d864354fa1209. Use the first monthly table; convert percent to decimal. US equity total return = (Mkt-RF + RF)/100. Cash = RF/100. No ETF replication is claimed. Current reconstructed history, not a 1999 data-library vintage. Retrieval uses a revision-pinned public mirror of the source payload; no raw payload is redistributed in this repository.

sources.source_name: Federal Reserve H.15 via FRED
sources.notes: Retrospective archive used for outcomes. Publication date is that of the pinned public mirror revision (https://github.com/BuyRisk/buyrisk.github.io/commit/c51c5c9592bf2de0758b7b2ed13a35930516fefa), not original market reporting or first dataset publication. Canonical source: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/GS5. Series: GS5. Raw SHA256: b03972bed533eeffebe1d9b54d7e52dc5a67b0119cc82ebd92d799fbc184c165. Monthly average five-year constant-maturity Treasury yield. Synthetic rolling five-year par bond: monthly coupons, flat yield curve, one coupon plus repriced 59 remaining monthly payments. No credit/spread exposure or bond-fund fees; not a broad aggregate index. Uses preceding month yield for coupon, current month yield for repricing. Retrieval uses a revision-pinned public mirror of the source payload; no raw payload is redistributed in this repository.
